description: Validate that users can click on a product and view detailed information.
steps: Wait for the product details page to load.
Verify that the product name, price, description, and 'Add to Cart' button are visible.
expected_results: The product details page is displayed with all relevant information.
Users can see options to add the product to their cart.
edge_cases: Product link leads to a 404 error.
Product details page is missing critical information.
Add to Cart button is disabled or missing.
data_requirements: Product details must be available in the backend.
Valid links to navigate to the product details page.
dependencies: Product details must be stored in the backend.
Links to product pages must be correctly configured.
api_interactions: API call to fetch product details.
Error handling for missing product data.
performance_metrics: Product details page load time should be under 3 seconds.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure product details are accessible via screen readers.
Add to Cart button must be keyboard navigable.
